newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor to sell assets of nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor to sell assets of nuclear plant.

text.p: The Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Tuesday it would auction off the assets of a mothballed nuclear plant next month under a bidding process.
At least six foreign companies have expressed interest in buying the assets of the Philippine Nuclear Power Plant.
The bidding is expected to yield at least $36 million for the state-owned power firm, Napocor said.
Interested bidders include the power units of General Electric Co plc, Siemens AG, and Asea Brown Boveri AG.

The 620-megawatt nuclear plant was built in the 1980's but was never commissioned due to a legal debacle between the government and its builders, Westinghouse Electric Corp and Burns & Roe of the U.S.
The sale will not include the plant building itself as there is a plan to put up a natural gas-fired power plant at the site.
